subject: globalsort: reduce number of SST ingested into TiKV (#59870) (#60045)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent with focus on add-index globalsort (DDL ingest). Main behavior changes: (1) global-sort range splitting now derives range job size/keys from node CPU:mem ratio via `handle.GetNodeResource()` + `external.CalRangeSize()` instead of a fixed 96MB; (2) cloud write+ingest now passes task concurrency into `ingest.CreateLocalBackend` (lowering `WorkerConcurrency`) and supplies per-step `MemCapacity` into external engine creation; (3) domain initializes and publishes validated node resources (CPU>0, mem>0), so the new ratios are non-nil/non-zero in normal runtime. Checked for Blocker/High risks (nil/div-by-zero, workerConcurrency==0 loops, metadata/state-machine regressions, compatibility with old subtask meta): none found given the existing invariants/validation paths.
